subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving validated conversions for {Brand}, the completed registration with a verified profile rather than the raw install. The one point worth repeating: we read every sign-up back through a server-to-server postback off your MMP, held through your anti-bot and photo-verification checks, so you pay only for clean profiles. At scale we hold around 3,200 validated conversions a day at that quality bar. If it helps, I can pull the cohort read by metro and age band. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate validated-conversion + S2S postback proof
illustrative_flags: 3,200 validated conversions a day (MobUpps-specific daily validated-registration volume; illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN social_and_dating: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (validated conversion = verified-profile registration + S2S postback via MMP + anti-bot/photo-verification hold); one illustrative MobUpps figure (3,200 validated conversions/day); soft CTA, exactly one question mark; no sign-off; native English; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y' comma-negation (phrased positively as 'rather than the raw install').
